blocks.html:
Premium Quality Van Wraps in GTA starting from $450

Thinking of advertising your business? Why not use all that real estate on your company vehicles to showcase your services? Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to wrap your fleet vehicles and turn them into moving billboards. It could be a commercial wrap or promotional wrap. We have expert designers who are capable of designing anything you can imagine. Vehicle wraps are considered optimal for advertising a business because of the following reasons:

  • You get to decide everything, from the design to the amount of area to be covered.
  • A huge spectrum of colours to choose from.
  • Vinyl wraps come in various finishes such as matte, gloss, satin, etc.
  • Vehicle wraps last for years which means no monthly paid campaigns. Pay once to get the wrap and forget about it for years to come.
  • Vinyl wraps require minimal maintenance.
  • Wraps protect the original paint of your vehicle.
  • Advertising using vehicle wraps is considered non-aggressive because only people who are interested will be looking at your vehicle, thus increasing the chances of getting more potential clients.

Some of the vans we have wrapped include but are not limited to:

  • Ford Transit
  • GMC Savana
  • RAM ProMaster
  • Toyota Sienna
  • Nissan Quest
  • Honda Odyssey
  • Dodge Caravan
  • Dodge Promaster
  • Chevrolet Express
  • Mercedes Sprinter
  • Ford Connect
